description: This file defines the 'Delete' feature within the Comments namespace of a C# ASP.NET Core application, including the command to delete a comment and its handler logic.

classes.name: Delete
classes.description: Container class for the delete comment feature.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to delete a comment identified by slug and comment ID.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the delete command to ensure the slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion process: retrieves the article, finds the comment, removes it, and saves changes.

methods.name: CommandValidator.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the validator with rules; checks that Slug is not null or empty.

methods.name: QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the comment deletion by accessing the database context, handling not found errors, and saving changes.
